title: Transmitter
description: Field transmitter shown as an instrument bubble with a device status (IND-080 .. IND-083).

status.description: Device status after the NAMUR NE 107 categories: ok, failure, check (function check), out_of_spec, maintenance (IND-081). While failure, the value is shown invalid (IND-082).

status_text.description: Optional detail of the status, e.g. the diagnostic message.

tag.description: Instrument tag, e.g. LT-101: function letters above the line, loop number below (IND-080).
